knownDeltas: The crate currently exposes contract-backed structural specifications and token resolution helpers rather than mounted GPUI widgets.
Semantic-role and scroll ownership intent are explicit in the API, but native accessibility-tree and viewport-node plumbing remain later runtime work.
Token usage and layout meaning are frozen here so later GPUI widgets do not invent structural semantics ad hoc.
nonGoals: Do not treat this crate as proof that broader GPUI primitive parity is complete.
Do not bypass emitted tokens with local Rust constants for structural spacing, surface, border, elevation, or focus treatment.
Do not reopen DAW-specific ownership or workstation-only behavior under the banner of structural primitives.
